skills.group.help: Manage updates of the third-party skill sources.
skills.list.help: List the third-party sources with the active version, the newest one seen and the changelog link.
skills.error.state_invalid: The third-party state file {path} is invalid ({why}).
skills.check.help: Check the registries for newer versions of the third-party sources.
skills.check.daily: Session-start mode: do nothing unless a day has passed, and print the hook JSON only when an update is available.
skills.decline.help: Record that the newest version of a source was declined, so it is not offered again.
skills.decline.source: The source name (rea, agent-skills or wev-skills).
skills.error.nothing_to_decline: No newer version of {name} has been seen yet; run `wev skills check` first.
skills.hook.updates: Third-party skill updates: {items}. Ask the person once; on yes run `"${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/bin/wev" skills update <source>`; on no run `"${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/bin/wev" skills decline <source>`.
skills.install.help: Download a version of a source and install it beside the others, without making it active.
skills.install.version: The version to install (default: the newest one).
skills.install.next_steps: To make it active, run `wev skills update {name}`.
skills.error.install_failed: Could not install {name} ({code}); nothing was left behind.
skills.health.spawn_failed: The health check could not run the program (exit {exit}).
skills.health.timeout: The health check did not finish in time.
skills.health.bad_jsonrpc: The server answered with something that is not valid MCP.
skills.health.reply_too_large: The server's reply is longer than the {limit} MiB limit (stopped after {seen} characters).
skills.health.no_tools: The server started but lists no tools.
skills.health.no_skills: No skill files were found in this version.
skills.health.bad_skill: The skill in directory {dir} is invalid (name or description).
skills.health.version_mismatch: The installed program reports a different version than the one released.
skills.error.frozen: {name} is frozen; run `wev skills freeze {name} --off` first.
skills.error.declined: {version} of {name} was declined; pass --yes to update anyway.
skills.error.busy: Another update of {path} is switching it now; try again.
skills.error.no_previous: {name} has no previous version to roll back to.
skills.error.previous_missing: The previous version {version} of {name} is no longer on disk.
skills.error.not_installed: {name} is not installed; run `wev skills update {name}` first.
skills.error.bad_skill_name: Refusing to link a skill with an unsafe name: {name}.
skills.error.foreign: {path} exists and was not created by wev; move it away first.
skills.update.help: Install the newest version of a source and make it active, only if its health check passes.
skills.update.source: The source to update (default: every source that is not frozen).
skills.update.yes: Update even to a version that was declined.
skills.rollback.help: Make the previous version of a source active again.
skills.freeze.help: Stop checking and updating a source.
skills.activate.help: Link the active agent-skills into the skill directories of Claude Code and of Codex, OpenCode and Gemini.
skills.deactivate.help: Remove the links that `wev skills activate` made, and only those.
skills.show.help: Show the state of a source and, for rea, the command that starts its MCP server.
